run_query_zero_shot_classification: run the query function to perform zero-shot image classification on a given image with candidate labels
create_function_query: create a function that reads an image file, encodes it as base64, and sends it to the Hugging Face Inference API for zero-shot classification
test_query_function: test the query function with an image path and candidate labels to verify zero-shot classification output
refactor_query_function: refactor the query function to accept an image bytes object directly instead of a file path
summarize_query_function: summarize the query function that sends a base64-encoded image to the Hugging Face Inference API for zero-shot image classification
